panels.title: SCROLL
panels.action: CUSTOMER WORLD (photocopy: toner on newsprint, orange the only live colour, on threes). Orange sun drops in; phone rises with its feed scrolling; SCROLL is already rising on frame 1.
panels.sound: Paper tap, felt word-hit, short whoosh

panels.title: SCROLL
panels.action: SCROLL bleeds off the left edge; orange underline slides under it; receipt ticker flips in top-right; accents pop on the 8ths.

panels.title: STREAM
panels.action: Navy band wipe → navy ground. Cream TV lands inside a pulsing blue sun; play triangle snaps in; progress bar runs.
panels.sound: CRT thunk, play pop, hum bed

panels.title: SEARCH
panels.action: Ring wipe → orange. Search pill lands with impact squash; query types on 2-frame keystrokes; magnifier swings in on a loose spring.
panels.sound: Card thump, 6 soft key ticks, result ping

panels.title: RIDE
panels.action: Cream band wipe. Navy road slams across on a diagonal, dashes rushing; orange car drives the road with squash & stretch; pin drops and lands.
panels.sound: Whoosh, small car pass (panned L→R), pin thump + boop

panels.title: PAY
panels.action: Hard cut to sky blue. Orange card winds back then swings in on an arc and taps the terminal; cream ripples; orange tick pops.
panels.sound: Card tap, NFC two-note chime (B, F#), positive chime

panels.title: The receipt
panels.action: Ring wipe to navy. The whole day prints out as one long receipt, a line every half-beat.
panels.copy: YOUR DAY · MADE IN THE USA · SPENT IN INDIA
panels.sound: Paper swoosh, printer ticks per line

panels.title: The receipt
panels.action: Total line prints with a blinking orange ‘?’; the question slides in beside the receipt.

panels.title: The 0
panels.action: On the hole in the music a giant orange 0 slams over everything (slams from 160 to 100 percent, paper shake); receipt and question dim.
panels.sound: Reverse swell → sub drop + cardboard slam + paper debris; music ducks 6 dB

panels.title: The 0
panels.action: Camera pushes into the 0's counter; frame floods orange.

panels.title: Locked
panels.action: Inside the 0: a navy padlock drops in and lands; the question type slides in from the left.

panels.title: Locked
panels.action: Padlock rattles in its shackle — ‘it isn't for you’.

panels.title: Not anymore
panels.action: On the bass return the colours flip (orange lock on navy); the cream key snaps a quarter-turn; NOT slams, ANYMORE. follows 3 frames later.
panels.sound: Lock mechanism + tonal hit; music ducks

panels.title: Not anymore
panels.action: Shackle springs open; the lock tumbles out of frame.

panels.title: The door
panels.action: Cut-paper door frame rises; the orange door swings open on a heavy spring; light pours out across the floor.
panels.sound: Card thump, door swing, shimmer (in key)

panels.title: The door
panels.action: Camera pushes through the doorway into the light.

panels.title: Tunnel
panels.action: The build: the day's objects (search, car, card, play, phone) orbit a growing orange sun on stickers.

panels.title: Tunnel
panels.action: Rush: the stickers fly at camera, speed streaks, sunburst.
panels.sound: Paper flutters panned L/R, reverse cymbal

panels.title: Vacuum
panels.action: 15.2 s vacuum: everything freezes, pulls back and drains; a ghost of the orange sun flickers in.
panels.sound: Half a second of true silence

panels.title: THE DROP
panels.action: THE SWITCH. On the downbeat the photocopied sheet rips down the middle (on ones) and both halves fly off; underneath, full colour: sun slam, navy band, US drops, STOCKS slides in.
panels.sound: Paper rip + sub boom + cardboard slam + crash; music ducks 3 dB

panels.title: THE DROP
panels.action: OWNER WORLD (full palette, on twos, springs). US and STOCKS pulse weight/width on every kick; NOW ON MAPS pops on the sun; stock tiles run along the band.

panels.title: THE DROP
panels.action: Hold: the poster breathes (sun scale), camera drifts back.

panels.title: Pick
panels.action: Orange band wipe. Phone lands in a blue sun; thumb swipes the brand-safe stock cards twice (snap springs).

panels.title: Pick
panels.action: Thumb picks the third card; it grows on the right with a 'slice' wedge filling (no price chart — SEBI ad code). 'Illustrative · not a recommendation'.

panels.title: Buy
panels.action: Thumb presses BUY: impact frame (cream flash ring + speed lines), tick pops; BUY FROM INDIA chip slams in.
panels.sound: Button thunk, positive chime, word hit

panels.title: The stack
panels.action: Hard cut to navy: big certificates land one per beat on tilted arcs (Nº 000 001 → 004).

panels.title: The stack
panels.action: Messy stack settles; accents pop.

panels.title: Proof line
panels.action: The top certificate lifts to camera until it IS the frame; the proof line is set big on it; a slice sticker snaps in as the full stop; risk footer appears.
panels.copy: Own a slice of the brands you use every day.

panels.title: The last dab
panels.action: Ring wipe to cream. Sun lands; ‘Customer by habit.’ snaps in from the left.

panels.title: The last dab
panels.action: The song's break: camera leans in (anticipation).

panels.title: The last dab
panels.action: Downbeat: navy band slams in, ‘Shareholder by choice.’ stamps (shake), orange underline draws, ‘Customer’ dims.
panels.sound: Rubber stamp + paper crunch + tonal hit; brush stroke

panels.title: End card
panels.action: MAPS Global Markets pops on the final hit; US STOCKS · NOW OPEN; one CTA button (GET THE MAPS APP) presses on every beat.
panels.copy: MAPS Global Markets · US STOCKS · NOW OPEN · GET THE MAPS APP

panels.title: End card
panels.action: The orange sun peeks back in from the right → loops into the opening shot.
